section: 11. Ruins of Saint Mogius: Cult Traces
description: The Saint Mogius Church has become ruins, with dragon traces and cult activities widespread. A "Devil Simulacrum" tracking scroll is hidden in a secret compartment.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: The poet staggers and rolls in through the hole, gets up covered in dust, squints and looks around—"Ha! Welcome to the Byzantine luxury underground suite—" He coughs twice hoarsely, "Equipped with antique furniture, and... uh... a few long-sleeping distinguished guests." This is an underground tomb, filled with the scent of dust and ancient death. Dim light leaks in through the broken hole, outlining neatly arranged stone burial slabs. Most are well-preserved, but three have been violently smashed, with bones scattered messily on the ground. The empty eye sockets of the skulls stare upward, as if silently accusing. Suddenly, you discover a Frankish knight lying face up on the cold stone floor of the tomb, wisps of white smoke rising from the gaps in his armor. His sword lies two steps away, the blue-glazed family crest on the hilt already cracked.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: Anatolia. This dragon has no language ability, only beast-level intelligence. Its actions are purely driven by predatory instinct. The only "control" method recorded in history is St. George's mithril weapon (or similar holy damage), or killing it outright.

conversation.speaker: player7
conversation.text: #Continue to recall where that weapon should be now, and whether this dragon has any special abilities.

conversation.speaker: player9
conversation.text: #Clank clank, squat by the reservoir to check the water quality. If it's clean, scoop some water to wash.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: According to the legend of St. George, the weapon that can completely kill the Anatolian Dragon is St. George's mithril spear, Ascalon. Legend says the spearhead was soaked in holy blood, granting absolute lethality against evil. This weapon was last recorded as being stored in the crypt of the St. George Monastery in Antioch, secretly guarded by the Eastern Orthodox Church. Besides conventional fire breath and tough physique, the dragon's most dangerous special ability is its highly corrosive blood. Contact with wounds causes muscle dissolution. Legend says St. George nearly died from touching the dragon's blood. Additionally, its scales offer strong resistance to ordinary weapons; only silver weapons or sanctified arms can effectively penetrate.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Are you all planning to hold a memorial service here?" The poet kicks aside the scattered bones on the ground. He raises his voice, pointing toward the reservoir direction—the dull thuds of the dragon crashing against the stone walls are vibrating through the tomb chamber. "That thing won't wait for us to finish the eulogy!"
